bind_address.description: IP address to bind the signing service listener to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0')

port.description: TCP port for the signing service HTTP API

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle concurrent signing requests

keyring_path.description: Path to the GPG keyring directory containing signing keys and trustdb

default_key_id.description: GPG key ID (e.g., 'DEADBEEF') used by default if no key is specified per request

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for a signing operation before it times out

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (set to `true` for troubleshooting)

hmac_secret.description: Shared secret for HMAC-based request authentication; empty string disables HMAC validation

items.description: Trusted client IP or CIDR range (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24')

trusted_clients.description: List of IP ranges allowed to submit signing requests without HMAC validation

pattern.description: File path pattern (glob) that triggers signing

key_id.description: Specific GPG key ID for this policy; defaults to `default_key_id` if omitted

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the policy

signing_policies.description: List of file pattern → signing key mappings for automatic signing

log_max_size_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) of each log file before rotation

log_rotate_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep
